name: Souin Ningyou ~Obieru Shoujo-tachi~
original_name: 操淫人形～怯える少女たち～
source:
Main character was sorry for classmates bullied at former school, so in this new school he decides not to allow it. His former bullied classmate Marie transfers soon as well, but the victim starts to act like a bully for another girl this place. Protagonist arranges a seminar for both girls, but at some time he starts to violate them for his own pleasure.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vn-of-month-may-2008-g-senjou-no-maou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公曾为旧学校里遭受欺凌的同学感到痛心，因此来到新学校后，决心不再容许这种事发生。过去饱受欺凌的同学东堂真里亚不久也转学而来，却从受害者变成了欺凌另一名女孩的人。主人公为两名少女安排了一场讲座，后来却开始为了满足私欲侵犯她们。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/07/vndb-of-month-may-2008-g-senjou-no-maou.html]vndbreview[/url]]
